meta.name: Kinderly / Kin — warm editorial parenting companion
meta.description: Design DNA extracted from the Kinderly (Kin) product: the logged-in application (24 screens crawled), the login screen, the marketing site, and nine additional app screens rendered in the marketing 'See Kinderly in action' section. Characterised by a warm bone canvas, deep pine ink, Instrument Serif display and prose type over Geist UI type, pill controls, hairline-bordered white surfaces, a floating pill bottom navigation, and calm slow motion.
source_references: https://app.kinderly.ai — authenticated session, 2026-11-11, 24 screens crawled: children list, child onboarding, Kin chat, Today/forecast, Stories list + detail + create, Settings + personal/email/password/two-step/invite/family/calendar, Learn library + article, Recipes, Kin Picks, calming tools (breathing), child baseline
https://www.kinderly.ai/ (marketing site, hero, voices, product section)

https://www.kinderly.ai/ 'See Kinderly in action' — 9 app screens: profile, ask Kin chat, voice & text, visual story, calming tools, visual schedule, weekly forecast, printables library, celebration jar
CSS custom properties exposed on app.kinderly.ai (:root, 51 tokens)
Computed styles sampled from the live DOM (buttons, inputs, cards, rows, bubbles, chips, bottom nav)

primary.role: Deep pine. All body text on the app, primary button fill, brand mark, logo wordmark.

secondary.role: Terracotta. Warm action accent: microphone orb, active dots, illustration fills, occasional emphasis.

accent.role: Marigold. Celebration and positive highlight: jar marbles, tag highlights, background wash tint.

neutral.usage: Lightest three are page and card surfaces (bone). Mid sages carry chips and illustration fills. #728173 is secondary/muted text, #3D5141 is mid ink, #173220 is body text and controls, #0D2014 is the phone-frame near-black.

color.contrast_strategy: Dark-on-light dominant. Deep pine ink over warm bone; no pure black or pure white in text surfaces. Surface separation comes from small value steps plus 1px hairlines, not heavy shadows.

font_families.heading: Noto Serif SC (subset, 400), Songti SC, STSong, serif

typography.font_style_notes: Display headings are a high-contrast, slightly condensed serif set at 400 weight — never bolded. In the logged-in app the serif is also used for reflective prose (18px/1.5), while all controls, labels and metadata use Geist at 13–16px with weights 400/500/600. App h1 runs 30–40px depending on the surface (Recipes/Detail 30, Settings/Children 34–36, Learn 40), not the 56–80px marketing scale. A third accent face, Gochi Hand, appears for hand-drawn labels in product illustrations. The serif/sans pairing is the primary identity carrier; do not substitute a geometric display sans. The reference UI ships in English and French only, so it provides no evidence for Chinese typography — the Chinese serif decision is ours, not the reference's. Mobile h1 measures 36px/37.8px/-0.4px. Long-form Learn articles use Geist at 17px/300 for body and 17px/600 for section headings — serif is reserved for reflective summaries and display, not article body. Chinese serif decision (2026-11-11): Noto Serif SC 400, self-hosted as a subset and loaded with wx.loadFontFace; Songti/STSong remain as fallbacks. Chinese typography adaptation (decision B): H1 30px/1.35/0, serif body 17px/1.8/0, other serif headings keep the same 1.35 line-height and zero tracking.

spacing.section_rhythm: 96px vertical section padding on marketing; 24px mobile gutter and 80px desktop gutter. App screens keep a single left axis with 20–24px side padding and 24–32px between groups.

layout.grid_system: App: a single mobile-first column ~880px wide centred on desktop (measured 914px incl. gutters), bottom nav floating over it. Marketing: single centered column capped at 1120px, splitting into text plus a horizontally scrolling phone row (gap 36px).
layout.alignment_tendency: App column centered on desktop but content strictly left-aligned inside it; marketing hero centered with the same left-aligned content blocks.

shape.border_usage: 1px hairline rgba(23,50,32,.1) on inputs, list rows, chips and cards; 1px solid pine on secondary buttons. App cards cluster at 20px, feature cards at 22–26px, avatars at 32px or 50%. Hairlines are the default separator — never 2px+ borders.
shape.divider_style: 1px rgba(23,50,32,.1), full-bleed or inset, very low contrast.

elevation.shadow_style: Soft diffused; shadows are rare and reserved for floating objects (phone frames). Cards rely on white fill + hairline instead of shadow.

levels.high: 0 28px 60px -22px rgba(0,0,0,.55) — phone frame over the marketing surface

elevation.depth_cues: Color value steps and hairlines first; shadows only for physically floating objects.

iconography.style: Two explicit tiers, both measured from /picks. (1) UI icons: 24×24 viewBox, currentColor, zero fill, line only, 1.6–2.0 stroke chosen per icon by optical weight; content bbox roughly 4–20 with 2–5 asymmetric padding; 1–5 elements. (2) Illustration tiles: 120×120 viewBox, hand-drawn flat shapes with a 3px pine outline plus 2px detail and 4–6px accent strokes, round caps and joins, rounded rects (rx 10), and 1–3 solid fills from the earth palette. Subject bbox spans 52–80 wide. No gradients, no shadows, no multi-tone shading. The /picks page uses 12 such tiles at 128×128 inside soft circular or rounded-square backdrops.
iconography.stroke_weight: UI icons 1.6–2.0 per icon (measured 1.6 / 1.7 / 1.9 / 2.0 across 27 samples); illustrations 3 outline, 2 detail, 4–6 accent — never a single global width
iconography.preferred_set: Custom inline SVG only. UI icons inherit currentColor; illustrations keep pine outlines and palette fills. No third-party icon set, no icon font in the reference product.

motion.entrance_pattern: Fade + rise: opacity 0→1 with translateY 64px→0 and scale .98→1 over 1.15s. Chat bubbles, schedule ticks, forecast bars and jar marbles each have their own staggered keyframe.
motion.exit_pattern: Fade out only; no scale or slide exits observed.
motion.philosophy: Calm, slow and breathing. Nothing bouncy, no spring physics, no attention-seeking loops; 36s linear marquees are the only continuous motion.

components.button_style: App: pill (999px), 48px tall, 14.5px/500 Geist, padding 12px 20px; primary is pine fill with bone label, secondary is a sage-tinted pill or a text link with a chevron. Marketing: the same pill at 56px / 17px/600. Shadows only on the floating nav, never on buttons. Disabled state is 60% opacity on the same fill; the product does not render inline validation errors — the CTA simply stays disabled until required fields are valid.
components.input_style: 52px tall, 14px radius, white fill, 1px rgba(23,50,32,.22) border, 16px pine text; focus adds a 3px rgba(23,50,32,.12) halo instead of changing the border colour. Search/filter fields are pill-shaped with a leading icon.
components.card_style: App cards are white (#FFFFFF) or bone-cool (#FCFAF4), 20px radius by default and 22–26px for feature cards, 1px hairline border, no shadow, 20–24px padding. A card may invert to pine or sage-deep for emphasis, keeping the same radius.
components.navigation_pattern: Floating white pill bottom nav, 5 items (Kin, Children, Today, Stories, Settings), pinned near the bottom with a soft shadow rgba(23,50,32,.35) 0 10px 30px -14px. Inactive items are ink-soft (#728173) icon + 16px label; the active item gets a sage pill background behind icon and label. A circular pine FAB with a terracotta glyph sits bottom-right above it. Screen headers are a left-aligned serif h1 plus an optional pill action on the right.
components.modal_style: Two observed patterns, no centred dialog. (1) Bottom sheet: white panel anchored to the bottom, top corners 24px, padding 14px 20px 24px, drag handle, scrim rgba(23,50,32,.55); rows are 16px/400 with a 14.5px pill cancel button. (2) Destructive confirmation is a dedicated full-page route (/settings/delete) with a #A8323A primary pill and a transparent 'Keep' secondary — not a modal.
components.list_style: Settings and profile sections are bone-cool (#FCFAF4) cards at 20px radius containing hairline-separated rows; actionable rows are white at 16–20px radius with a chevron. Rows run ~56–64px with 14–16px Geist labels and 12–13px muted metadata. Schedule rows pair a 16px square checkbox (3px radius, sage fill, sage-deep border) with 16px text.
components.component_notes: Signature devices observed in the authenticated app: (1) mood is captured as a weather trio — Sunny / Cloudy / Stormy cards — instead of a numeric scale; (2) tags are inline text highlights (sage or marigold behind words), not pill chips; (3) chat bubbles use asymmetric tail radii (white 18px 18px 18px 5px for Kin, pine 10px 3px 10px 10px for the parent); (4) a three-segment dashed progress line communicates '3 check-ins to unlock' without a progress bar; (5) overline labels are 12px uppercase with 0.14em tracking; (6) illustration tiles are a distinct asset class — 120-grid, pine outline, palette fills — never recoloured into a single mono tint; (7) inline tooltips are pine surfaces (#173220) with bone text, 12px radius, 10px 12px padding, 12.5px text and a soft shadow; disabled icon buttons drop to 35% opacity while disabled primary buttons drop to 60%; (8) search fields are 48px pill labels on #F2EDDE with a transparent 16px input, and filter chips are 28px with a selected state of 20% sage fill plus a 1px pine border; (9) #8A94A3 is a secondary label colour used on Picks overlines and the Calming tools header (the one cool neutral in an otherwise warm palette), and Picks related cards are white with a 12px radius instead of the recipe cards' 18px; (10) Picks index adds a second cool tint, #EBEFF9, on the Sleep category tile, and lays categories out as a mosaic (126 / 143 / full-width 64 heights) rather than a uniform grid; (11) the Picks category page uses a third filter-chip style — white fill with #E4E2D6 border, selected #E5EFE9 with a pine border — so chips are intentionally per-surface, not a single global component.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: Warm paper, pressed botanicals and a well-kept notebook — clinical knowledge delivered like a letter, not a dashboard.
aesthetic.era_influence: Contemporary editorial wellness (2020s), with a serif revival and earthy 1970s palette.

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Generous and structural. App screens place content in the top half and leave the lower third empty; whitespace is what makes the product feel calm rather than the palette alone.
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Top-heavy with a strong left axis; large type carries the weight, secondary content stays small and muted.
visual_language.contrast_level: High text contrast, low surface contrast — pine on bone is strong; adjacent surfaces differ by only a few value steps.
visual_language.texture_usage: No noise or patterns. Depth comes from layered radial washes (marigold at 16%, sage at 50%) behind the hero.

composition.flow_direction: top-to-bottom on a left axis; marketing hero centres the same content
composition.grouping_strategy: whitespace plus hairline separators; almost no boxes
composition.negative_space_role: carries the emotional message — space is the product's calm

imagery.photo_treatment: Natural-light, candid child photography, warm and slightly desaturated; rounded rectangles (16–24px), no duotone or heavy filters.
imagery.illustration_style: Hand-drawn flat SVG on a 120×120 grid: 3px pine outline (#173220) with 2px detail lines and 4–6px accent strokes, round caps and joins, rounded rectangles (rx 10), 1–3 solid fills from a five-colour whitelist (#C36540 terracotta, #8DA386 sage, #DDB14A marigold, #FCFAF4 card bone, #173220 pine). Subject bbox 52–80 wide, 36–80 tall. No gradients, no shading, no clipart gloss. Rendered at 128×128 on a soft sage/marigold circular or rounded-square backdrop.
imagery.graphic_elements: Circular brand mark, inline text highlights, marble/jar metaphor, hairline rules.
imagery.image_shape: Rounded rectangle 16–24px; avatar circular with a 2px sage-deep ring.

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Quiet. Colour and opacity shifts; state changes are confirmed by content, not by animation.
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Subtle opacity/lift on marketing links and pills; no colour inversion.

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Gentle reassurance plus one concrete next step; never a bare 'no data'.
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: non-blaming and practical — state what happened, then what to try.

overview.fallback_strategy: CSS gradients and keyframes only; degrades to static surfaces with no functionality loss.

background_effects.description: Layered radial washes behind the hero: marigold rgba(221,177,74,.16) at top centre, sage rgba(207,217,196,.5) at lower left, over a bone base. Static, not animated.
background_effects.technology: CSS radial-gradient stack on a pseudo-element

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: Each section on enter (v2-reveal on IntersectionObserver)

text_effects.description: No per-character or gradient text animation.

image_effects.description: No filters or reveal animations on photography; images are static and simply rounded.

canvas_drawings.description: The jar illustration is inline SVG, not canvas.

svg_animations.description: Inline SVG jar with marbles that drop into place (kin-v2-drop); small breathing/pulse keyframes elsewhere. All decorative, never required to understand content.

visual_effects.composite_notes: Layered effects are limited to the marketing hero (gradient washes + scroll fade-up + a 36s horizontal phone marquee). The app screens themselves are effect-free by design: flat bone canvas, hairline surfaces, one accent colour. Note that the measured login screenshot reports #f2ede2 as background while the CSS token is #ece6d7 — the difference is the login page's lighter card surface and anti-aliasing, not a second palette. Element-level CSS variables (51 tokens) are the authoritative source for exact values.
